d_ruling_on_the_authors_refusal_of_the_o.verdict: THE AUTHOR WAS RIGHT, and this is not a close call.
reasoning: No such percentage is derived anywhere in the repository. I searched for one. ADR 0011's trigger says 'substantially a replication'. The frontier check quantifies nothing about overlap. reviewer_record.reanalysis.json's claim_boundaries contain no figure of this kind. There is no artifact, no command and no method that would produce an 80%.

A bare '80%' in the opening paragraph of the most public artifact this repository has would be claim-shaped prose citing no ID and traceable to no artifact - the exact defect this review was asked to hunt in question 2, and the exact defect the prior reviewer recorded as the citation test's known blind spot. Publishing it would have made the disclosure paragraph itself the strongest instance of the failure the document is about.

It would also be a quantity with no definable denominator. Eighty per cent of what - of the findings, of the compute, of the pages, of the certified quantities? The repo's honesty boundary does not permit a number whose unit cannot be stated.

This is not a dodge of the disclosure. The disclosure the owner asked for is that the work is substantially a replication and that the CRC-extraction result is not ours. The draft makes that disclosure, first, bolded, and by name. Only the unevidenced quantifier was declined, and declining it left the disclosure no weaker.
d_ruling_on_the_authors_refusal_of_the_o.one_refinement_recommended_not_required: The draft says 'most of what we measured'. The committed record says 'substantially'. 'Most' carries a faint arithmetic implication (more than half) that 'substantially' does not. Quoting the record's own word costs nothing and removes the last thread a hostile reader could pull. See W13.

section_7_the_lede.ruling: THE AUTHOR IS RIGHT. The evidence supports the grounding-perp-certifiability lede and does not support the apparatus lede. This is not a balance of considerations; four independent lines all point the same way.
reasoning: 1. THE APPARATUS CLAIM IS NOT IN THE LEDGER, AND THIS REPOSITORY'S DOCTRINE FORBIDS LEADING WITH AN UNLEDGERED CLAIM. There are fourteen claims in evidence/plan4/claim_ledger.json. None concerns review process, audit counts, BLOCK counts, or the efficacy of the gate discipline. CLAUDE.md: 'Nothing is a claim until it traces to committed evidence.' REVIEW.md's first repo-specific gate: 'every metric in the README/report/cards traces to a committed evidence artifact + the command that produced it.' A lede is the single most public sentence in the document. Putting the one unledgered assertion there inverts the repository's own rule at the point of maximum exposure.

2. IT IS UNFALSIFIABLE SELF-REPORT AT n=1, AND THE WITNESS IS THE APPARATUS. The claim is that the gate discipline caught errors that would otherwise have shipped. There is no control arm, no counterfactual, and no comparison project. The evidence that the reviewer has 'real authority' is the reviewer's own records. The author's own disclaimer concedes all of this - 'We do not know that these errors would have shipped absent the apparatus' - which is an unusual thing to concede about your own headline, and is the tell that it cannot BE the headline. You cannot lead with a claim whose supporting paragraph is a statement that you cannot establish it.

3. THE CHOSEN LEDE IS LEDGERED, CONFIRMED AND NAMED AS THE CONTRIBUTION BY THE ADR. CX-GROUNDING-ORTHOGONAL-01 is status `qualified`, holds README + report + abstract surfaces, cites two committed artifacts, and its verified_by records 'numbers CONFIRMED by from-scratch recomputation'. ADR 0011 section 2 ends: 'Grounding and certifiability are orthogonal for this task. That is the contribution; the grounding number on its own is not.' The draft's title and subtitle are that sentence. A lede that quotes the ADR's own designation of the contribution is the correct lede by construction.

4. A RECORDED, REVIEWED POSITIONING DECISION ALREADY EXISTS AND SAYS SO. docs/plan3/HANDOFF-2026-07-22-reanalysis.md, under 'Still open', on the write-up as the next unit of work: 'Positioning = science-of-evaluations (grounding-perp-certifiability for grounded EAE; here is a $0 diagnostic).' That handoff sits behind a four-pass independent review whose publication gate was lifted. Leading with the apparatus would reverse a recorded decision without an ADR, which is itself a doctrine breach under CLAUDE.md's gated-doctrine convention.
section_7_the_lede.what_the_owner_is_right_about: The instinct is not baseless, and I want it on the record that I do not think it is. The apparatus story IS the most unusual thing in this repository - a reviewer BLOCKing a paid GPU run over a bit-exact token mismatch, a reviewer catching a sealed-split path that would have made the disclosure mechanism itself emit a false attestation, and a reviewer logging a defect against wording it had itself supplied are not common.
